theorems.name: Submission.dph_lipschitz_pushforward_im
theorems.statement: (∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ j : ℕ, θ x = j) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → ∀ (g : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith Λ g → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → IsCompact (g ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl Q)) k, IsLipschitzPushforward X g S ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ ∀ (gj : ℕ → Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ' : ℝ≥0), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (gj j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ' (gj j)) → TendstoUniformly gj g atTop → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl Q)) k, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ (gj j) x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k) (gj j x)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → 0 < r → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening r X.support) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → (∀ (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (O : Set (Eucl m)) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj n)) → (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x‖ ≤ L) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop O → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
